newsitem.title: USA: Vermont jobless rate stays at 3.9 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Vermont jobless rate stays at 3.9 pct in Feb.

text.p: Vermont's unemployment rate in February remained at 3.9 percent, the state Department of Employment and Training said, as manufacturers added jobs, while retail trade lost them.
The latest rate, which was down from the year-ago level of 4.5 percent, was interpreted as a continuing recovery though job growth was not outpacing last year's level.
"The latest unemployment data appeared to confirm the January improvement in labor market conditions," said Susan Auld, the department's Commissioner, in prepared remarks released on Tuesday.
"However, jobs data continued to show modest growth similar to that experienced in 1996," she added.
The manufacturing industry added 350 jobs, largely due to hirings by apparel producers and printing shops. But retail trade shed 1,050 jobs, and goods producers lost 400.
